<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false()"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="e1" cond="$count = 1 || $done" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e2" cond="$count % 2 = 0" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e3" cond="$count AND $done" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e4" cond="fn:concat('a', 'b') = 'ab'" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e5" cond="contains('a')" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e6" cond="$count = 'open" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e7" cond="$ count = 1" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e8" cond="$count/sideways::x" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e9" cond="$count/@" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e10" cond="$done ? 1 : 0" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e11" cond="$count === 3" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e12" cond="$count = 1;" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e13" cond="$count[1 = 1" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e14" cond="$count >" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e15" cond="$count = 1 and not $done" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e16" cond="cuont($count) = 1" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e17" cond="!($done or $count = 1)" target="b"/>
    <transition event="e18" cond="$count = 1 $done" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: xpath syntax error in `cond`: `||` is not an XPath operator
notes: a condition that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` and evaluates as false, so this condition can never hold
diagnostics.help: XPath spells logical or as `or`; a single `|` is the node-set union
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §5.9 Expressions
SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model
